Play with friends

Advanced: extra TURN relay (a shared one is built in)

Some networks (4G, school or office Wi-Fi) block direct links. A TURN relay forwards the traffic. Get a free one at metered.ca (Open Relay), then paste its credentials URL here, or lines of turn:host:port user password. Usually it is enough for the host to set it; set it on both sides if it still fails.

Glossary

Everything we know

How to play

Gather the Krystals

  1. The Hub. Pick one of the 13 Krystalkers and up to 3 gems at the Round Table (you swap on the spot), read the Archive, train on dummies, and set out through the Expedition Gate. At home sprinting is free and ultimates are unlocked; the Krystal Hourglass in the Training Yard turns cooldowns off.
  2. Biomes. Each biome is a group of rooms with its own monsters and a broken altar (◇). Restore it (F) to start the biome's challenge. The altar shows the recommended level, with ☠ in red when you are below it.
  3. Challenges. The biome seals: nobody inside can leave, but allies can still walk in to help. Monsters keep pouring in and the biome's boss rises in one of its rooms. Inside and outside cannot see each other. Beat the boss and the altar becomes a Krystal Shrine for levelling. If everyone inside falls, the challenge fails. The Wildfire burns seals open.
  4. Boss chests. Every boss drops a chest. Each player opens it once and picks 1 of 3 relics. Bosses with a higher recommended level give better odds. Unopened chests stay marked on your map.
  5. Gold flies straight to your purse and is shared by the whole team. Rooms slowly refill with monsters to farm; a conquered biome only gets a few scattered stragglers. Two linked teleporter rooms (◎) connect far corners of the map.
  6. The Wildfire ignites twice per Act and closes on a Gatekeeper; its last ring always holds the whole Gatekeeper arena. When a Gatekeeper falls its doors open, but the fire keeps burning outside the ring until the next Act is announced. Brave the flames to set off early and get a head start on Act II. Act II is longer and has stronger monsters. After Gatekeeper II a portal opens to The Bazaar. Its northern portal leads to the Dungeon Master's own arena.
  7. The Dream Palace. The whole castle is one great lair that sleeps until its altar is restored. Then every hall wakes at once (its monsters never come back once slain) and three tower guardians rise (Lv 10). Beat all three and the Keep's master rises in its wide throne hall (Lv 13). Clearing it is the surest way to max level (15). Plan for it in Act II with a full team.
  8. Dead? Press 1, 2 or 3 to watch a teammate. If they are sealed in a challenge, you only see what is right around them.
  9. Recommended level. Bosses and Dream Palace monsters have a recommended level (Gatekeeper I: 5, Gatekeeper II: 10, Dungeon Master: 15). Every level you are below it, you deal 8% less damage and take 12% more. Cleared rooms slowly refill with monsters to farm.

Elements and weaknesses: Fire, Frost, Bleed, Poison, Shock, Shadow. Bosses list their weakness: matching hits deal +50%, matching damage over time deals double. A frozen boss is freeze-immune for 12s.

Death. Only during a Gatekeeper or Dungeon Master fight can a fallen ally be revived. Anywhere else, falling means death: you respawn at a shrine one level lower, and all your gold (plus that level's cost) stays where you fell. The spot is marked on your map and by an arrow at the edge of the screen. Die again before you get back and it is gone.

Flasks. You start with 2 flasks (R): each heals 20% of your health. Standing at a Krystal Shrine with no enemies near refills your flasks and health. Nine to twelve small rooms hold Krystal Fonts (⚱): your map shows where they are, but not how to get there. Channel one for 5 seconds (taking damage breaks it) and your own flasks get +1 flask and heal more. Each Font serves only one Krystalker, so share them out; every Font is restored when Act II begins. Six upgrades (8 flasks, 65% each) is the most anyone can reach, and only two Krystalkers per run can get there. You no longer heal over time on your own: flasks, shrines, healers and some gems or relics are your only healing.

Downed during a boss: teammates can revive you; each down makes the next revive slower (up to the third). Beating a Gatekeeper or Dungeon Master revives everyone on the spot. If the whole team is down, the expedition fails.

Controls: LMB attack · RMB secondary (melee) attack · Space movement skill · Q character skill · E ultimate (unlocks at level 10) · R drink a flask · T active item · F interact / revive · Shift sprint · G stickers.

Sprint drains stamina (the bar under your feet). Run it dry and you must wait until it is completely full again. Most Krystalkers cannot attack while sprinting; Crow, Rabbit, Serpent and Red Lizard can.

Passives. Every Krystalker has one always-on trait (Hedgehog's Spiny Back, Polar Bear's Polar Hide…). Read them in the Archive or at the Round Table.

On-hit relics trigger on every hit of your attacks. The Red Lizard's fireballs hit so often that their on-hit chances (and Storm Heart and Thunderlord's Antler) count only half.

Krystal Shrines restore you to full health while no monsters are nearby. If you die while exploring, you return at the nearest shrine that the Wildfire will not reach.

Ping with the middle mouse button, or click anywhere on the full map (M). Pinging an enemy calls your bots to attack it; pinging a spot sends them there.

Play with friends: on the title screen pick Play with friends. One player hosts and gets a 5-letter room code; the others join with it (up to 4 players). Everyone meets in the Hub, each Krystalker can only be picked once, and only the host can start the expedition from the Gate. Empty slots are filled with bots, and a bot takes over if someone disconnects. Win or lose, the host brings everyone back to the Hub. The game runs on the host's computer: give that job to the player with the best connection.

Gems: win a run to find 5 random gems. A lost run still gives a few, mostly common: 1 if you fall in Act I, 2 in Act II, 3 at the Dungeon Master. Each Krystalker also has 3 legendary gems unlocked by personal quests.
